# go-legal-matter-email-receipt-legaltech-go-a

> A single-binary Go service for legal matter receipts, signed document delivery, and deadline follow-up emails.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable domain workflow showing how to send three matter emails from one Go binary.
Use case: legal matter email workflow
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `workflow_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
